description: Conformal welding constructs simply connected domains by specifying boundary arc identification. Carroll-Ortega-Cerda used it to prove existence of harmonically symmetric slit domains. Parameterizing the welding homeomorphism enables systematic search for extremal B_u domains.
mathematical_formalization: Given h: S^1 -> S^1, find f_+: D -> Omega_+, f_-: C_hat\D_bar -> Omega_- with f_+ = f_- o h on S^1. Parameterize h by Fourier coefficients, optimize B_u.
analogical_connections: Welding homeomorphism ~ diffeomorphism matching in image registration
implementation_hypothesis: Parameterize h as identity + Fourier perturbation. Solve welding problem numerically. Optimize Bloch radius over Fourier coefficients using CMA-ES.
experiment_seed: Start with identity welding, perturb with n=3 harmonics, optimize to maximize Bloch radius.
